title: Bell MTS email outage, Nov 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Bell MTS, Bell Canada, any news outlet, government agency, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: Bell MTS email customers across Manitoba were locked out for more than two days, per CBC and the Free Press. Bell has not said how many customers or accounts were affected, so size rests on reach, not a count.
who_is_affected: Bell MTS email customers in Manitoba, many locked out from about Nov 17 to Nov 20 and some for longer. Bell says it will contact customers whose data may have been affected.

known.text: Bell MTS email customers in Manitoba were locked out for days, and Bell said on Nov 20 that service was restored.
Bell gave no cause for the outage until Nov 22.
Bell says an agentic attacker stole enterprise customer data from its systems on Nov 17.
Bell says it shared details with the Canadian Centre for Cyber Security and is working with the RCMP's cybercrime unit.

not_known.text: Whether a second outlet or Bell's own notice carries the cyberattack statement.
How many customers or accounts were affected, and what data was reachable.
Whether the email outage is linked to Bell Canada's Nov 17 breach, which Bell calls a separate attack.
